                    "body": {
                      "size": 2284,
                      "base64_url_content": null,
                      "content": "---------- Forwarded message ---------\r\nFrom: Oeuf Déjeuner <ooeuf.ca@gmail.com>\r\nDate: Thu, Feb 12, 2026, 09:41\r\nSubject: Demande urgente de représentation – Dossier Quadro Holdings Ltée\r\nc. Harmony Movers\r\nTo: <felix.cotton@aecom.com>\r\n\r\n\r\nBonjour,\r\n\r\nNous sollicitons votre assistance urgente afin d’obtenir une représentation\r\njuridique pour notre entreprise, Quadro Holdings Ltée, dans un litige\r\nactuellement devant la Cour supérieure du Québec.\r\n\r\nNous sommes impliqués dans un dossier opposant notre entreprise à la\r\ncompagnie Harmony Movers (9205-2471 Québec inc.), dans lequel une demande\r\nintroductive d’instance avec saisie avant jugement a été déposée, puis\r\namendée en janvier 2026.\r\n\r\nNotre procureur initial est présentement indisponible pour des raisons\r\npersonnelles, ce qui nous place dans une situation critique sur le plan\r\nprocédural. La partie adverse a récemment entrepris des démarches visant le\r\nrejet de notre demande, invoquant l’absence de représentation dans les\r\ndélais.\r\n\r\nCompte tenu des échéances imminentes et des enjeux financiers importants,\r\nnous sommes activement à la recherche d’un avocat pouvant prendre le\r\ndossier en charge dans les plus brefs délais.\r\n\r\nLe dossier concerne notamment :\r\n\r\n- La rétention illégale d’équipements commerciaux d’une valeur estimée à\r\nplus de 250 000 $ ;\r\n- Des pertes d’exploitation et dommages réclamés ;\r\n- Une saisie avant jugement déjà exécutée ;\r\n- Une demande en rejet présentable prochainement devant le tribunal.\r\n\r\nNous sommes en mesure de fournir immédiatement l’ensemble des documents,\r\nprocédures, pièces et communications nécessaires à l’analyse du dossier.\r\n\r\nNous vous serions reconnaissants de bien vouloir nous indiquer rapidement\r\nsi vous êtes en mesure d’assurer notre représentation ou, à défaut, de nous\r\nréférer à un confrère disponible.\r\n\r\nÉtant donné l’urgence de la situation, nous demeurons disponibles en tout\r\ntemps pour un appel ou une rencontre rapide.\r\n\r\nNous vous remercions sincèrement de votre attention et espérons pouvoir\r\ncompter sur votre collaboration.\r\n\r\nVeuillez agréer, nos salutations distinguées.\r\n\r\nCordialement,\r\n\r\nPierre Lévesque\r\nQuadro Holdings Ltée\r\nTéléphone : 514-458-4587\r\n",
                      "attachment_id": null
                    },

                      "size": 2278,
                      "base64_url_content": null,
                      "content": "---------- Forwarded message ---------\r\nFrom: Oeuf Déjeuner <ooeuf.ca@gmail.com>\r\nDate: Thu, Feb 12, 2026, 09:28\r\nSubject: Demande urgente de représentation – Dossier Quadro Holdings Ltée\r\nc. Harmony Movers\r\nTo: <cc@savonitto.com>\r\n\r\n\r\nBonjour,\r\n\r\nNous sollicitons votre assistance urgente afin d’obtenir une représentation\r\njuridique pour notre entreprise, Quadro Holdings Ltée, dans un litige\r\nactuellement devant la Cour supérieure du Québec.\r\n\r\nNous sommes impliqués dans un dossier opposant notre entreprise à la\r\ncompagnie Harmony Movers (9205-2471 Québec inc.), dans lequel une demande\r\nintroductive d’instance avec saisie avant jugement a été déposée, puis\r\namendée en janvier 2026.\r\n\r\nNotre procureur initial est présentement indisponible pour des raisons\r\npersonnelles, ce qui nous place dans une situation critique sur le plan\r\nprocédural. La partie adverse a récemment entrepris des démarches visant le\r\nrejet de notre demande, invoquant l’absence de représentation dans les\r\ndélais.\r\n\r\nCompte tenu des échéances imminentes et des enjeux financiers importants,\r\nnous sommes activement à la recherche d’un avocat pouvant prendre le\r\ndossier en charge dans les plus brefs délais.\r\n\r\nLe dossier concerne notamment :\r\n\r\n- La rétention illégale d’équipements commerciaux d’une valeur estimée à\r\nplus de 250 000 $ ;\r\n- Des pertes d’exploitation et dommages réclamés ;\r\n- Une saisie avant jugement déjà exécutée ;\r\n- Une demande en rejet présentable prochainement devant le tribunal.\r\n\r\nNous sommes en mesure de fournir immédiatement l’ensemble des documents,\r\nprocédures, pièces et communications nécessaires à l’analyse du dossier.\r\n\r\nNous vous serions reconnaissants de bien vouloir nous indiquer rapidement\r\nsi vous êtes en mesure d’assurer notre représentation ou, à défaut, de nous\r\nréférer à un confrère disponible.\r\n\r\nÉtant donné l’urgence de la situation, nous demeurons disponibles en tout\r\ntemps pour un appel ou une rencontre rapide.\r\n\r\nNous vous remercions sincèrement de votre attention et espérons pouvoir\r\ncompter sur votre collaboration.\r\n\r\nVeuillez agréer, nos salutations distinguées.\r\n\r\nCordialement,\r\n\r\nPierre Lévesque\r\nQuadro Holdings Ltée\r\nTéléphone : 514-458-4587\r\n",
                      "attachment_id": null
                    },

                      "content": "---------- Forwarded message ---------\r\nFrom: Chabot, Karl <KChabot@lavery.ca>\r\nDate: Fri, Feb 13, 2026, 10:39\r\nSubject: RE: Demande urgente de représentation – Dossier Quadro Holdings\r\nLtée c. Harmony Movers\r\nTo: Oeuf Déjeuner <ooeuf.ca@gmail.com>\r\n\r\n\r\nBonjour,\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nMerci pour votre courriel. Je ne pourrai malheureusement pas vous assister\r\n– toutefois, vous pouvez communiquer avec le Barreau du Québec, lequel\r\noffre un service de référence que vous trouverez ici : Service de référence\r\n– Trouver un avocat | Barreau du Québec\r\n<https://www.barreau.qc.ca/fr/grand-public/acces-justice/services-reference/>\r\n\r\nVous y trouverez également des liens vers d’autres sites de référence qui\r\npourraient possiblement vous mettre en contact avec un(e) avocat(e).\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nSincères salutations,\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n*Karl Chabot*\r\n\r\nAssocié / Partner\r\nAvocat / Lawyer\r\n\r\n*T *514 878-5428\r\n* KChabot@lavery.ca <KChabot@lavery.ca>*\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n*Vcard  *FR <https://www.lavery.ca/upload/vcard/Karl-Chabot-fr.vcf> — EN\r\n<https://www.lavery.ca/upload/vcard/Karl-Chabot-en.vcf>\r\n* Profil  *FR\r\n<https://www.lavery.ca/fr/avocats-parajuristes-notaires-lavery/profil/Karl-Chabot/>\r\n— EN\r\n<https://www.lavery.ca/en/lawyers-paralegals-notaries-lavery/profile/Karl-Chabot/>\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n*De :* Oeuf Déjeuner <ooeuf.ca@gmail.com>\r\n*Envoyé :* 12 février 2026 09:22\r\n*À :* Chabot, Karl <KChabot@lavery.ca>\r\n*Objet :* Demande urgente de représentation – Dossier Quadro Holdings Ltée\r\nc. Harmony Movers\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n Ce courriel provient d'un expéditeur externe. Soyez vigilant avant\r\nd'ouvrir une pièce jointe ou de cliquer sur un lien.\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nBonjour,\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nNous sollicitons votre assistance urgente afin d’obtenir une représentation\r\njuridique pour notre entreprise, Quadro Holdings Ltée, dans un litige\r\nactuellement devant la Cour supérieure du Québec.\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nNous sommes impliqués dans un dossier opposant notre entreprise à la\r\ncompagnie Harmony Movers (9205-2471 Québec inc.), dans lequel une demande\r\nintroductive d’instance avec saisie avant jugement a été déposée, puis\r\namendée en janvier 2026.\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nNotre procureur initial est présentement indisponible pour des raisons\r\npersonnelles, ce qui nous place dans une situation critique sur le plan\r\nprocédural. La partie adverse a récemment entrepris des démarches visant le\r\nrejet de notre demande, invoquant l’absence de représentation dans les\r\ndélais.\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nCompte tenu des échéances imminentes et des enjeux financiers importants,\r\nnous sommes activement à la recherche d’un avocat pouvant prendre le\r\ndossier en charge dans les plus brefs délais.\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nLe dossier concerne notamment :\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n- La rétention illégale d’équipements commerciaux d’une valeur estimée à\r\nplus de 250 000 $ ;\r\n\r\n- Des pertes d’exploitation et dommages réclamés ;\r\n\r\n- Une saisie avant jugement déjà exécutée ;\r\n\r\n- Une demande en rejet présentable prochainement devant le tribunal.\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nNous sommes en mesure de fournir immédiatement l’ensemble des documents,\r\nprocédures, pièces et communications nécessaires à l’analyse du dossier.\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nNous vous serions reconnaissants de bien vouloir nous indiquer rapidement\r\nsi vous êtes en mesure d’assurer notre représentation ou, à défaut, de nous\r\nréférer à un confrère disponible.\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nÉtant donné l’urgence de la situation, nous demeurons disponibles en tout\r\ntemps pour un appel ou une rencontre rapide.\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nNous vous remercions sincèrement de votre attention et espérons pouvoir\r\ncompter sur votre collaboration.\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nVeuillez agréer, nos salutations distinguées.\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nCordialement,\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nPierre Lévesque\r\n\r\nQuadro Holdings Ltée\r\n\r\nTéléphone : 514-458-4587\r\n",

style=\"font-family:&quot;Calibri&quot;,sans-serif;color:black\"><u></u> <u></u></span></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><span><u></u> <u></u></span></p>\r\n<div>\r\n<div style=\"border:none;border-top:solid #e1e1e1 1.0pt;padding:3.0pt 0cm 0cm 0cm\">\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><b><span lang=\"FR\" style=\"font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Calibri&quot;,sans-serif\">De :</span></b><span lang=\"FR\" style=\"font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Calibri&quot;,sans-serif\"> Oeuf Déjeuner &lt;<a href=\"mailto:ooeuf.ca@gmail.com\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noreferrer\">ooeuf.ca@gmail.com</a>&gt;\r\n<br>\r\n<b>Envoyé :</b> 12 février 2026 09:22<br>\r\n<b>À :</b> Chabot, Karl &lt;<a href=\"mailto:KChabot@lavery.ca\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noreferrer\">KChabot@lavery.ca</a>&gt;<br>\r\n<b>Objet :</b> Demande urgente de représentation – Dossier Quadro Holdings Ltée c. Harmony Movers<u></u><u></u></span></p>\r\n</div>\r\n</div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><u></u> <u></u></p>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><span style=\"color:white;background:#74be64\"> Ce courriel provient d&#39;un expéditeur externe. Soyez vigilant avant d&#39;ouvrir une pièce jointe ou de cliquer sur un lien. </span><u></u><u></u></p>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"background:#ffeb9c’\">\r\n <u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">Bonjour, <u></u><u></u></p>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><u></u> <u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">Nous sollicitons votre assistance urgente afin d’obtenir une représentation juridique pour notre entreprise, Quadro Holdings Ltée, dans un litige actuellement devant la Cour supérieure du Québec.<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><u></u> <u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">Nous sommes impliqués dans un dossier opposant notre entreprise à la compagnie Harmony Movers (9205-2471 Québec inc.), dans lequel une demande introductive d’instance avec saisie avant jugement a été déposée, puis amendée en janvier 2026.<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><u></u> <u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">Notre procureur initial est présentement indisponible pour des raisons personnelles, ce qui nous place dans une situation critique sur le plan procédural. La partie adverse a récemment entrepris des démarches visant le rejet de notre demande,\r\n invoquant l’absence de représentation dans les délais.<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><u></u> <u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">Compte tenu des échéances imminentes et des enjeux financiers importants, nous sommes activement à la recherche d’un avocat pouvant prendre le dossier en charge dans les plus brefs délais.<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><u></u> <u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">Le dossier concerne notamment :<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><u></u> <u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">- La rétention illégale d’équipements commerciaux d’une valeur estimée à plus de 250 000 $ ;<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">- Des pertes d’exploitation et dommages réclamés ;<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">- Une saisie avant jugement déjà exécutée ;<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">- Une demande en rejet présentable prochainement devant le tribunal.<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><u></u> <u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">Nous sommes en mesure de fournir immédiatement l’ensemble des documents, procédures, pièces et communications nécessaires à l’analyse du dossier.<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><u></u> <u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">Nous vous serions reconnaissants de bien vouloir nous indiquer rapidement si vous êtes en mesure d’assurer notre représentation ou, à défaut, de nous référer à un confrère disponible.<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><u></u> <u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">Étant donné l’urgence de la situation, nous demeurons disponibles en tout temps pour un appel ou une rencontre rapide.<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><u></u> <u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">Nous vous remercions sincèrement de votre attention et espérons pouvoir compter sur votre collaboration.<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><u></u> <u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">Veuillez agréer, nos salutations distinguées.<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><u></u> <u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">Cordialement,<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><u></u> <u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">Pierre Lévesque<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">Quadro Holdings Ltée<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n<div>\r\n<p class=\"MsoNormal\">Téléphone : 514-458-4587<u></u><u></u></p>\r\n</div>\r\n</div>\r\n</div>\r\n</div>\r\n</div>\r\n\r\n</div>\r\n",

                  "size": 27851,
                  "base64_url_content": null,
                  "content": "---------- Forwarded message ---------\r\nFrom: Oeuf Déjeuner <ooeuf.ca@gmail.com>\r\nDate: Mon, Dec 29, 2025, 02:29\r\nSubject: Question\r\nTo: yan romanowski <romanowskiyan@gmail.com>\r\n\r\n\r\nSujets\r\n\r\n1). Les échanges pré contrat\r\n*The Exchange Before Signing the Contract*\r\n*At the time these events occurred, we were under pressure due to a\r\ndeadline imposed by our landlord to vacate our commercial space. As a\r\nresult, we began searching online for a moving company capable of handling\r\nheavy-duty restaurant equipment, as we needed to relocate an entire\r\npizzeria.*\r\n*During this search, we came across the website of Harmony Movers, a\r\ncompany located in Lachine, with the destination of the move being LaSalle.\r\nBased on their location and advertised services, we believed this company\r\nto be an appropriate and suitable choice for our needs.*\r\n*We subsequently contacted Harmony Movers by phone and spoke with a company\r\nrepresentative. During this initial conversation, we clearly explained our\r\nsituation and specified that the move involved the complete contents of a\r\npizzeria, including all restaurant equipment. The discussion was explicitly\r\nabout moving an entire pizzeria, not a partial or limited selection of\r\nitems.*\r\n*During this exchange, the representative requested that we send\r\nphotographs of the equipment by text message to the owner of the company,\r\nwhose name is Lev. We complied with this request and sent multiple images\r\nvia text message. A conversation then took place directly between us and\r\nLev, during which these images were reviewed.*\r\n*After receiving the images, Lev stated that the move involved only nine\r\nitems. However, if one reviews the images that were sent prior to the\r\nsigning of the contract, it is clear that this statement does not reflect\r\nthe reality shown in the photographs. The images visibly display\r\nsignificantly more equipment, and by direct observation, approximately 27\r\nseparate pieces of equipment can be identified.*\r\n*Furthermore, during these exchanges, we explicitly informed him that the\r\ncontract had to include the entire pizzeria equipment. This point was made\r\nclearly and without ambiguity.*\r\n*Following these discussions, Harmony Movers agreed to proceed, provided us\r\nwith a price and an estimate, and advised us that in order to reserve the\r\nservice, we were required to sign the contract and provide a credit card.\r\nWe were informed that the credit card was needed to create and reserve the\r\ncontract, and that payment would only be processed once the service was\r\nfully completed and rendered.*\r\n*The contract itself stipulated that the service consisted of transporting\r\nand delivering our equipment to our other location, which was the\r\nagreed-upon destination.*\r\n\r\n2) la journée de l’enlèvement au resto ( pas la saisie). Qui y était? À\r\nquelle heure t’es arrivé. Les échanges et discussions . Ce qui n’a pas été\r\nenlevé .\r\n*Events on the Day of the Move*\r\n*On the day of the scheduled move, Pierre Levesque and Costa Cronis were\r\npresent on site early in the morning to prepare the premises and ensure\r\neverything was ready for the arrival of Harmony Movers. They arrived on\r\nsite at approximately 7:00 a.m. to begin preparations.*\r\n*According to the contract and prior agreement, Harmony Movers was supposed\r\nto arrive at 8:00 a.m., or at the latest 9:00 a.m. However, Harmony Movers\r\ndid not arrive within the agreed timeframe. Instead, they arrived at\r\napproximately 11:30 a.m., several hours late.*\r\n*Upon their arrival at 11:30 a.m., the Harmony Movers staff entered the\r\npremises and began walking around, inspecting the equipment and assessing\r\nthe scope of the job. For approximately one hour and thirty minutes, no\r\nequipment was moved at all. During this time, the staff did not perform any\r\nmoving services and instead stated that they needed to contact their boss\r\nto discuss a different pricing structure, claiming that the job was not\r\nwhat they thought or what they had agreed to.*\r\n*It was apparent from their conduct that they were attempting to\r\nrenegotiate the terms and pricing of the contract after arrival on site. It\r\nalso appeared that they were attempting to take advantage of the situation,\r\ngiven that the owner was of an older age, by pressuring him to agree to a\r\nnew arrangement under time constraints.*\r\n*At that point, Pierre Levesque and Costa Cronis discussed the situation\r\nand decided to contact their nephew, Matthew Wallace, to explain what was\r\nhappening and seek guidance. After this discussion, Pierre and Costa\r\nstepped away.*\r\n*Despite no work being performed, the Harmony Movers staff remained on site\r\nand continued charging hourly fees, even though they were not moving any\r\nequipment and were only attempting to renegotiate the contract.*\r\n*Pierre Levesque then spoke directly with Matthew Wallace and stated:*\r\n*“Matthew, I do not agree with what they are trying to do right now. We\r\nhave a contract, and they are supposed to respect it. We have a deadline.\r\nThis equipment must be out of the space by tomorrow. We are not in a\r\nposition to call another company. I do not agree with any modification to\r\nthis contract.”*\r\n*After this conversation ended, Matthew Wallace contacted Lev, the owner of\r\nHarmony Movers. Matthew explicitly informed Lev that he was on his way to\r\nthe site, that he was renting a U-Haul truck in order to move the pastry\r\nequipment into storage, and that he would arrive within approximately one\r\nhour to assess the situation in person.*\r\n*Matthew also made it clear to Lev that:*\r\n*No contract changes were authorized*\r\n*All requests or proposed changes had to be sent by email*\r\n*An explanation was required as to why Harmony Movers was attempting to\r\nchange pricing when a contract had already been signed and clearly defined\r\nthe scope of work*\r\n*Lev acknowledged this and stated that they would send the information by\r\nemail.*\r\n*During this time, Harmony Movers continued attempting to negotiate\r\ndirectly with Pierre Levesque. Pierre Levesque and Costa Cronis, meanwhile,\r\ncontinued their duties on site and began preparing the restaurant contents\r\nby placing items into boxes, as the entire restaurant had to be cleared by\r\nthe following day.*\r\n*At approximately 2:30 p.m., Matthew Wallace Barnard arrived on site with\r\ntwo employees. Matthew and his two employees immediately began moving the\r\npastry equipment into the U-Haul truck parked outside in order to clear\r\nspace and comply with the landlord’s deadline.*\r\n*Harmony Movers then began moving some equipment as well. Shortly\r\nthereafter, the owner of Harmony Movers arrived on site. He walked around\r\nthe premises inspecting the equipment and approached Matthew Wallace,\r\nasking whether the Coca-Cola refrigerators were for sale, stating that they\r\nmight be interested in purchasing them.*\r\n*Matthew replied that all of the equipment belonged to a pizzeria and had\r\nto be relocated to another location, as Pierre Levesque intended to open a\r\nnew restaurant elsewhere.*\r\n*The owner then stated that they were not sending an additional truck and\r\nagain attempted to push for a change in rates and pricing. Matthew\r\nreiterated that he was not the owner, that he could not authorize any\r\nchanges, and that any requests had to be sent by email so the owner could\r\nreview them before authorizing anything. This email was not sent\r\nimmediately and was only sent later in the afternoon.*\r\n*The job continued for several hours. By approximately 4:00 p.m., Harmony\r\nMovers claimed that their truck was fully loaded and that they needed to\r\nproceed with delivery. Matthew then requested that Harmony Movers assist in\r\nloading some equipment into the U-Haul truck in order to maximize\r\nefficiency and help clear the space, particularly since they were charging\r\nby the hour and were claiming that a second truck would be required.*\r\n*Instead of proceeding to the agreed destination, Harmony Movers left the\r\nsite and did not deliver the equipment as stipulated in the contract. They\r\ntransported the equipment to their own warehouse and demanded payment\r\nbefore delivery.*\r\n*Additionally, Harmony Movers left critical equipment behind, including:*\r\n*A double-stack pizza oven*\r\n*Other pizzeria equipment*\r\n*A refrigerator*\r\n*These actions clearly demonstrated that they had no intention of\r\ncompleting the job as contracted, which required removal and delivery of\r\nall pizzeria equipment to the designated destination.*\r\n*Harmony Movers unilaterally changed the destination, attempted to increase\r\npricing, and imposed new conditions without any agreement or authorization,\r\ndespite the existence of a signed contract that they were obligated to\r\nrespect.*\r\n*At this point, Pierre Levesque was in a state of confusion and distress,\r\nbut was fully aware that if the equipment was not removed by the next day,\r\nownership could revert to the landlord. As a result of Harmony Movers’\r\nactions, Pierre Levesque was forced to urgently hire another company to\r\nmove the remaining pizza oven, refrigerator, and other equipment that\r\nHarmony Movers had abandoned on site.*\r\n\r\n3) les échanges post enlèvement . Les différents montants réclamés\r\n*Unjustified Revised Charges and Attempted Contract Modification*\r\n*Upon reviewing the revised submission that was sent later that same day,\r\nit became clear that Harmony Movers was attempting to impose new and\r\nunjustified charges that were never agreed upon and were not supported by\r\nthe facts on site.*\r\n*First, they attempted to charge for a second truck, despite the fact that\r\nno second truck ever arrived on site at any time during the move.*\r\n*Second, they attempted to charge for additional staff. However, the only\r\nadditional individuals who arrived on site beyond the original moving crew\r\nwere the owners of the company themselves, and these individuals did not\r\nmove, lift, or handle any equipment or materials from the premises. No\r\nadditional labor services were provided that would justify such charges.*\r\n*Third, they attempted to charge again for heavy-duty or heavyweight\r\nequipment. It is important to note that from the outset, it was clearly\r\nagreed and acknowledged that this was a restaurant move involving heavy\r\nequipment, and a specific fee of $1,800 had already been agreed upon for\r\nheavy-duty equipment and excess weight.*\r\n*Despite this clear agreement, Harmony Movers attempted to charge a second\r\nheavy-equipment fee, amounting to nearly $3,000, effectively billing twice\r\nfor the same category of service. This duplication of charges is entirely\r\ninconsistent with the original agreement and has no factual or contractual\r\nbasis.*\r\n*These attempted charges are particularly unjustifiable given that Harmony\r\nMovers was fully aware, prior to accepting the job and signing the\r\ncontract, that they were coming to move a complete pizzeria, including\r\nrestaurant equipment. The nature of the equipment was disclosed, documented\r\nwith photographs, and discussed before the contract was executed.*\r\n*The attempt to impose these additional fees, increase the hourly rate, and\r\nintroduce a new pricing structure after arrival on site, under severe time\r\npressure and with full knowledge of the landlord’s eviction deadline, was\r\nnot a legitimate contractual adjustment. It constituted an attempt to\r\ncoerce payment through pressure, rather than a good-faith modification of\r\nservices.*\r\n*At that point, the conduct amounted to extortion, as the company sought to\r\nleverage the urgent circumstances to extract additional payment without\r\njustification, authorization, or contractual support.*\r\n4). La journée de la saisie. Comment ça s’est passé ? Des menaces ? La\r\npolice ? Collaboration des employés ? L’avocat a-t-il menacé ou tenter\r\nd’intimider le huissier ? Quels équipements manquent ? Ça va pendre un\r\nestimé des réparations et valeur de l’équipement manquants\r\n*Harmony Movers, The Story (Continued)*\r\n\r\n*Missing Equipment and Final Documentation*\r\n\r\n*After completing a full inspection of the storage areas and the 53-foot\r\ncontainer, it became evident that a significant amount of equipment was\r\nmissing.*\r\n\r\n*Using the affidavits and inventory lists, the bailiff carefully:*\r\n\r\n*Verified which equipment had been recovered*\r\n\r\n*Identified which items were not present*\r\n\r\n*Formally noted all missing equipment*\r\n\r\n\r\n*All related documents were then handed over to the representative of\r\nHarmony Movers, and we were authorized to leave the premises.*\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Delivery to the Original Contract Destination*\r\n\r\n*Once the recovery process was completed, all retrieved equipment was\r\ntransported to 5505 Rue Irwin, LaSalle, Québec, which was:*\r\n\r\n*The original destination*\r\n\r\n*Clearly stated in the initial contract*\r\n\r\n*Where the equipment should have been delivered in the first place by\r\nHarmony Movers*\r\n\r\n\r\n*This additional handling was required solely because Harmony Movers failed\r\nto complete their contractual obligations.*\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Obstruction, Stalling, and Intimidation*\r\n\r\n*Throughout the process, we spent an excessive amount of time searching for\r\ngoods that were not located where Harmony Movers claimed they were stored.*\r\n\r\n*The landlord:*\r\n\r\n*Refused to assist*\r\n\r\n*Actively stalled operations*\r\n\r\n*Appeared to be waiting for his lawyer in an attempt to override or delay\r\nenforcement of the bailiff’s order*\r\n\r\n\r\n*He:*\r\n\r\n*Instructed employees not to identify themselves*\r\n\r\n*Directed staff to call the police*\r\n\r\n*Attempted to intimidate and delay the lawful recovery of goods*\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Condition of the Equipment*\r\n\r\n*Upon inspection, we found equipment:*\r\n\r\n*Lying directly on the floor*\r\n\r\n*With broken doors*\r\n\r\n*With compressors hanging*\r\n\r\n*Stored in a disorganized, unsafe, and negligent manner*\r\n\r\n\r\n*This condition was entirely inconsistent with the state of the equipment\r\nat the time it was picked up from: 6241 Boulevard Léger, Montréal-Nord, H1J\r\n6K4.*\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Request for Video and Photo Evidence*\r\n\r\n*Harmony Movers has stated that:*\r\n\r\n*They possess video footage*\r\n\r\n*They documented the pickup and handling of the equipment*\r\n\r\n\r\n*We are formally requesting that:*\r\n\r\n*All videos*\r\n\r\n*All photographs*\r\n\r\n*All documentation related to the pickup, transport, handling, and storage*\r\n\r\n\r\n*be submitted to the court, in order to demonstrate:*\r\n\r\n*How the equipment was moved*\r\n\r\n*How it was stored*\r\n\r\n*The condition in which it was maintained*\r\n\r\n\r\n*Given that Harmony Movers advertises itself as a leading company in\r\nMontréal for heavy equipment handling, the level of negligence observed is\r\ninexplicable and unacceptable.*\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Contractual Breaches and Billing Irregularities*\r\n\r\n*Under the original contract, Harmony Movers agreed to:*\r\n\r\n*Arrive at 8:00 a.m. (9:00 a.m. at latest)*\r\n\r\n*Pick up all equipment*\r\n\r\n*Deliver everything directly to 5505 Rue Irwin, LaSalle*\r\n\r\n\r\n*Harmony Movers later claimed there were only 9 photos documenting the\r\npickup.*\r\n*However:*\r\n\r\n*Images sent to Lev’s phone clearly total 17 photos*\r\n\r\n*These images show approximately 27 separate pieces of equipment*\r\n\r\n\r\n*This discrepancy raises serious concerns regarding misrepresentation and\r\nbilling manipulation.*\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Unauthorized Charges and Revised Billing*\r\n\r\n*Harmony Movers later attempted to:*\r\n\r\n*Add hourly charges for an extra worker (never provided)*\r\n\r\n*Charge for a second truck (never used)*\r\n\r\n*Add charges for “unexpected heavy equipment”*\r\n\r\n\r\n*However:*\r\n\r\n*A prior agreed charge of $1,800 for heavy equipment already existed in the\r\nsigned contract*\r\n\r\n*This charge was accepted by both parties*\r\n\r\n*No additional heavy-equipment fees were justified*\r\n\r\n\r\n*These revised charges were not authorized and did not reflect services\r\nactually rendered.*\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Intentional Contract Violation*\r\n\r\n*Harmony Movers attempted to:*\r\n\r\n*Replace the original contract with new rules and conditions*\r\n\r\n*Demand compliance with their revised billing and procedures*\r\n\r\n\r\n*Quadro Holding Ltée expressly refused, stating that:*\r\n\r\n*Only the original signed contract applied*\r\n\r\n*Any deviation constituted a breach*\r\n\r\n\r\n*The contract:*\r\n\r\n*Was signed by Pierre Lévesque*\r\n\r\n*Included a credit card on file*\r\n\r\n*Clearly stated that payment is due once the service is fully completed*\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Failure to Complete Service*\r\n\r\n*Harmony Movers:*\r\n\r\n*Left equipment behind at 6241 Boulevard Léger*\r\n\r\n*Failed to deliver all goods to 5505 Rue Irwin*\r\n\r\n*Redirected equipment to their storage facility without authorization*\r\n\r\n\r\n*They then:*\r\n\r\n*Refused to deliver the remaining equipment*\r\n\r\n*Demanded payment for revised charges*\r\n\r\n*Forced Quadro Holding to:*\r\n\r\n*Find another moving company*\r\n\r\n*Obtain additional insurance*\r\n\r\n*Assume risks that were not part of the original agreement*\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Refusal of Credit Card Payment*\r\n\r\n*Despite the contract clearly stating that:*\r\n\r\n*Credit card payment was mandatory*\r\n\r\n*The card would be charged upon completion of service*\r\n\r\n\r\n*Harmony Movers:*\r\n\r\n*Refused credit card payment*\r\n\r\n*Demanded cash or certified cheque*\r\n\r\n*Prevented the client from contesting charges*\r\n\r\n\r\n*This refusal appears intentional, particularly in light of:*\r\n\r\n*Missing equipment*\r\n\r\n*Damaged goods*\r\n\r\n*Incomplete service*\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Conclusion*\r\n\r\n*Quadro Holding Ltée:*\r\n\r\n*Refused to sign any revised agreements*\r\n\r\n*Refused unauthorized billing*\r\n\r\n*Acted strictly in accordance with the original contract*\r\n\r\n\r\n*The condition of the equipment, the missing items, and the refusal to\r\ncomplete delivery fully justify Quadro Holding’s position.*\r\n\r\n*Harmony Movers:*\r\n\r\n*Failed to respect the contract*\r\n\r\n*Withheld goods*\r\n\r\n*Imposed unauthorized charges*\r\n\r\n*Neglected equipment*\r\n\r\n*Obstructed lawful recovery*\r\n\r\n*Attempted to force payment before service completion*\r\n\r\n*Harmony Movers, The Story*\r\n\r\n*Chronology of Events – Thursday*\r\n\r\n*On Thursday morning, I presented myself at 9:00 a.m. at the premises of\r\nHarmony Movers for the recovery of restaurant equipment that had been\r\nseized and retained by Harmony Movers following a delivery in June.*\r\n\r\n*To execute this recovery properly, I had:*\r\n\r\n*Hired five employees*\r\n\r\n*Secured one truck*\r\n\r\n*Reserved a storage unit*\r\n\r\n\r\n*All arrangements were made to efficiently retrieve the equipment under\r\nlegal authority.*\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Arrival and Initial Refusal*\r\n\r\n*At approximately 10:00 a.m., a huissier (bailiff / justice officer)\r\narrived on site.*\r\n*We entered the reception area and were greeted by a secretary.*\r\n\r\n*We clearly informed her that:*\r\n\r\n*We were there to retrieve seized goods*\r\n\r\n*We had proper judicial documentation*\r\n\r\n*The huissier was present to execute a court order*\r\n\r\n\r\n*The secretary immediately refused access, stating she needed to contact\r\nher boss.*\r\n\r\n*After calling him, she informed us that the owner of Harmony Movers\r\nrefused to release any goods unless a balance of $4,500 was paid.*\r\n\r\n*The bailiff explicitly stated that:*\r\n\r\n*He was not there to negotiate*\r\n\r\n*His role was to execute the judge’s order*\r\n\r\n*Payment disputes were not relevant to the enforcement of the court\r\ndecision*\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Obstruction and Intimidation*\r\n\r\n*The bailiff asked the secretary to identify herself.*\r\n*She refused to do so and stated that police would be called to evict us if\r\nwe did not leave.*\r\n\r\n*The bailiff then:*\r\n\r\n*Presented his official identification and badge*\r\n\r\n*Explained clearly that she did not have the authority to refuse compliance*\r\n\r\n\r\n*A manager or director then intervened, attempting to diffuse the\r\nsituation. She stated that:*\r\n\r\n*There were “no bosses available”*\r\n\r\n*They were not authorized to allow entry or release of goods*\r\n\r\n\r\n*At this point, the bailiff stated he would:*\r\n\r\n*Return to the Palais de Justice de Montréal*\r\n\r\n*Obtain additional enforcement authorization*\r\n\r\n*Secure authority to enter the premises, change locks if required, and\r\nrecover the goods with police assistance*\r\n\r\n\r\n*He then left.*\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*False Cooperation and Continued Refusal*\r\n\r\n*Approximately 10 minutes later, the same lady exited the building and told\r\nme:*\r\n\r\n*They were not refusing access*\r\n\r\n*They needed to send documentation to the owner to obtain authorization*\r\n\r\n\r\n*I immediately contacted the huissier, asking him to return.*\r\n\r\n*Upon his return, the staff demanded that:*\r\n\r\n*He photograph their internal documents*\r\n\r\n*Without granting access to the premises*\r\n\r\n\r\n*The bailiff refused, explaining that:*\r\n\r\n*He does not photograph internal company documents*\r\n\r\n*Copies would be formally provided after his report was completed*\r\n\r\n\r\n*Once again, access was refused, and the landlord stated he would call the\r\npolice.*\r\n\r\n*To avoid further delay, the bailiff left again to obtain stronger court\r\nenforcement authority.*\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Police Intervention and Forced Access*\r\n\r\n*After approximately three hours, the bailiff returned, this time\r\naccompanied by police officers.*\r\n\r\n*Due to:*\r\n\r\n*Persistent refusal*\r\n\r\n*Obstruction*\r\n\r\n*Intimidation*\r\n\r\n*Threats involving police*\r\n\r\n\r\n*The authorities informed Harmony Movers that:*\r\n\r\n*Failure to comply would result in arrests*\r\n\r\n\r\n*At that point, the staff stated they wanted no involvement and told police\r\nand the bailiff to do whatever was necessary.*\r\n\r\n*We were finally granted access.*\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Refusal to Cooperate Inside the Premises*\r\n\r\n*Once inside, we asked: Where are the goods stored?*\r\n\r\n*The response:*\r\n\r\n*“I have no idea. Ask the landlord.”*\r\n\r\n\r\n*The landlord, contacted by phone, stated:*\r\n\r\n*It was not his job*\r\n\r\n*He would not assist*\r\n\r\n*He was calling his lawyer*\r\n\r\n\r\n*The bailiff then instructed us to locate the goods ourselves.*\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Discovery of Damaged Equipment*\r\n\r\n*While searching, I located a three-door refrigerator.*\r\n*From a distance, visible damage was evident—damage that did not exist\r\nprior to seizure.*\r\n\r\n*The bailiff immediately:*\r\n\r\n*Took notes*\r\n\r\n*Documented visible damage*\r\n\r\n*Authorized recovery operations*\r\n\r\n\r\n*After over an hour of searching, an employee finally arrived and guided us\r\nto a 53-foot container located outside.*\r\n\r\n*This was presented as the storage location.*\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Improper Storage and Severe Negligence*\r\n\r\n*Upon arrival, we discovered:*\r\n\r\n*Approximately 200 pallets blocking access*\r\n\r\n*Our goods located behind everything else*\r\n\r\n\r\n*Our employees were required to unload the container entirely to reach our\r\nequipment.*\r\n\r\n*Once accessed, it became clear that:*\r\n\r\n*Refrigerators were laid on their sides*\r\n\r\n*Equipment was unstable and falling*\r\n\r\n*Parts were broken or missing*\r\n\r\n*Items were heavily damaged*\r\n\r\n*No care, protection, or professional storage measures were taken*\r\n\r\n\r\n*This was particularly alarming given that Harmony Movers charged\r\napproximately $1,000 per month for “storage”, yet the equipment was:*\r\n\r\n*Stored outside*\r\n\r\n*In a truck*\r\n\r\n*Without protection*\r\n\r\n*In a state of neglect*\r\n\r\n\r\n*The bailiff documented all visible damages and conditions.*\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Excessive Delays and Operational Losses*\r\n\r\n*The recovery required:*\r\n\r\n*Two full truck trips*\r\n\r\n*Several hours of labor*\r\n\r\n*Replacing items exactly where they were found, as ordered*\r\n\r\n\r\n*What should have been a 3–4 hour operation turned into a 9-hour ordeal due\r\nto:*\r\n\r\n*Refusal to cooperate*\r\n\r\n*Obstruction*\r\n\r\n*Court order violations*\r\n\r\n*Police intervention*\r\n\r\n*Forced searches*\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n*---*\r\n\r\n*Conclusion*\r\n\r\n*Police were required to enforce a valid court order*\r\n\r\n*The bailiff formally documented:*\r\n\r\n*Damages*\r\n\r\n*Delays*\r\n\r\n*Non-compliance*\r\n\r\n*Threats*\r\n\r\n\r\n*Court procedures were not respected*\r\n\r\n*The landlord and company staff:*\r\n\r\n*Refused cooperation*\r\n\r\n*Issued threats*\r\n\r\n*Withheld information*\r\n\r\n*Obstructed justice*\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n*The equipment was recovered in damaged condition, following negligent\r\nstorage, unjustified delays, and clear resistance to lawful enforcement.*\r\n\r\n\r\nPhoto et description ou les équipements sont présentement .\r\n\r\n*Current Location and Condition of the Equipment*\r\n*The equipment is presently located at 5505 Rue Irwin, LaSalle, Quebec,\r\nwhere it has been placed in two storage containers within a storage unit.\r\nThe containers are properly sealed, securely closed, and stored in a heated\r\nenvironment. The equipment inside has been laid out and stored in an\r\norganized and appropriate manner to prevent further deterioration.*\r\n*At this time, we are awaiting the intervention of a qualified technician\r\nwho will be responsible for evaluating the condition of the equipment,\r\nassessing all damages sustained, and determining whether the equipment can\r\nbe repaired, salvaged, or must be declared unusable or scrap.*\r\n*This evaluation process will require additional time, particularly due to\r\nthe holiday period, which limits immediate availability. Furthermore,\r\narranging for a technician to attend the site involves financial costs,\r\nscheduling delays, and proper coordination with the appropriate\r\nprofessionals and organizations.*\r\n*Until this evaluation is completed, the full extent of the damages and\r\nassociated repair or replacement costs cannot yet be determined.*\r\n\r\nOn fait quoi avec les pertes de revenus qu’on réclame? Va falloir en faire\r\nla preuve et remettre tout document comptable ou autre\r\n\r\n*En analyse *\r\n\r\nDétail de combien ça coûté reprendre les biens\r\n\r\n*Costs Incurred as a Direct Result of the Move and Obstruction*\r\n*The costs associated with the relocation of the equipment and the actions\r\nthat followed are substantial and were incurred solely due to the\r\ncircumstances created by Harmony Movers.*\r\n*First, court-related expenses were required in order to obtain the CESI\r\nand to file the demande d’acheminement / agissement necessary to legally\r\nproceed with the recovery and relocation of the equipment. An amount of\r\n$2,000 was paid to the bailiff (huissier) to execute the legal process and\r\nattend the site in order to enforce the court authority related to the\r\nrecovery of the equipment.*\r\n*Second, an amount of $469 was paid to U-Haul for the rental of a truck,\r\nincluding the cost of the vehicle, fuel, and mileage, which became\r\nnecessary due to the failure of Harmony Movers to complete the move as\r\ncontracted.*\r\n*Third, we incurred an additional expense of approximately $2,000 for an\r\nalternative moving company, which was urgently required to provide\r\npersonnel and assistance to move the remaining equipment from Lachine to\r\nLaSalle and place it into the new storage location.*\r\n*In addition, we incurred a further expense of $400 for specialized\r\nequipment and tools required to safely load, secure, transport, and unload\r\nthe heavy-duty restaurant equipment into the truck and into the new storage\r\nfacility. These tools and materials were necessary to complete the move due\r\nto the nature and weight of the equipment involved.*\r\n*It is important to note that many of these costs could have been\r\nsignificantly reduced or avoided entirely had Harmony Movers complied with\r\ntheir contractual obligations and acted in good faith. Instead, Harmony\r\nMovers delayed the process, obstructed the execution of the move, and\r\ninterfered with the bailiff’s mandate, deliberately staggering time and\r\npreventing the bailiff from executing the recovery in a timely and lawful\r\nmanner.*\r\n*The bailiff explicitly warned Harmony Movers that their conduct was\r\nillegal, that they were tampering with a judicial officer, and that such\r\nactions exposed them to serious legal consequences, including the risk of\r\narrest. Despite these warnings, Harmony Movers persisted in their\r\nobstructive behavior.*\r\n*As a direct result of this conduct, we were forced to incur additional\r\nlegal, logistical, and operational expenses that would not otherwise have\r\nbeen necessary.*\r\n",

                  "content": "<div dir=\"auto\"></div><br><div class=\"gmail_quote gmail_quote_container\"><div dir=\"ltr\" class=\"gmail_attr\">---------- Forwarded message ---------<br>From: <strong class=\"gmail_sendername\" dir=\"auto\">Oeuf Déjeuner</strong> <span dir=\"auto\">&lt;<a href=\"mailto:ooeuf.ca@gmail.com\">ooeuf.ca@gmail.com</a>&gt;</span><br>Date: Mon, Dec 29, 2025, 02:29<br>Subject: Question<br>To: yan romanowski &lt;<a href=\"mailto:romanowskiyan@gmail.com\">romanowskiyan@gmail.com</a>&gt;<br></div><br><br><div dir=\"auto\">Sujets <div dir=\"auto\"><br></div><div dir=\"auto\">1). Les échanges pré contrat</div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>The Exchange Before Signing the Contract</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>At the time these events occurred, we were under pressure due to a deadline imposed by our landlord to vacate our commercial space. As a result, we began searching online for a moving company capable of handling heavy-duty restaurant equipment, as we needed to relocate an entire pizzeria.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>During this search, we came across the website of Harmony Movers, a company located in Lachine, with the destination of the move being LaSalle. Based on their location and advertised services, we believed this company to be an appropriate and suitable choice for our needs.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>We subsequently contacted Harmony Movers by phone and spoke with a company representative. During this initial conversation, we clearly explained our situation and specified that the move involved the complete contents of a pizzeria, including all restaurant equipment. The discussion was explicitly about moving an entire pizzeria, not a partial or limited selection of items.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>During this exchange, the representative requested that we send photographs of the equipment by text message to the owner of the company, whose name is Lev. We complied with this request and sent multiple images via text message. A conversation then took place directly between us and Lev, during which these images were reviewed.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>After receiving the images, Lev stated that the move involved only nine items. However, if one reviews the images that were sent prior to the signing of the contract, it is clear that this statement does not reflect the reality shown in the photographs. The images visibly display significantly more equipment, and by direct observation, approximately 27 separate pieces of equipment can be identified.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Furthermore, during these exchanges, we explicitly informed him that the contract had to include the entire pizzeria equipment. This point was made clearly and without ambiguity.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Following these discussions, Harmony Movers agreed to proceed, provided us with a price and an estimate, and advised us that in order to reserve the service, we were required to sign the contract and provide a credit card. We were informed that the credit card was needed to create and reserve the contract, and that payment would only be processed once the service was fully completed and rendered.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>The contract itself stipulated that the service consisted of transporting and delivering our equipment to our other location, which was the agreed-upon destination.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b><br></b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\">2) la journée de l’enlèvement au resto ( pas la saisie).  Qui y était?  À quelle heure t’es arrivé.  Les échanges et discussions .  Ce qui n’a pas été enlevé .</div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Events on the Day of the Move</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>On the day of the scheduled move, Pierre Levesque and Costa Cronis were present on site early in the morning to prepare the premises and ensure everything was ready for the arrival of Harmony Movers. They arrived on site at approximately 7:00 a.m. to begin preparations.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>According to the contract and prior agreement, Harmony Movers was supposed to arrive at 8:00 a.m., or at the latest 9:00 a.m. However, Harmony Movers did not arrive within the agreed timeframe. Instead, they arrived at approximately 11:30 a.m., several hours late.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Upon their arrival at 11:30 a.m., the Harmony Movers staff entered the premises and began walking around, inspecting the equipment and assessing the scope of the job. For approximately one hour and thirty minutes, no equipment was moved at all. During this time, the staff did not perform any moving services and instead stated that they needed to contact their boss to discuss a different pricing structure, claiming that the job was not what they thought or what they had agreed to.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>It was apparent from their conduct that they were attempting to renegotiate the terms and pricing of the contract after arrival on site. It also appeared that they were attempting to take advantage of the situation, given that the owner was of an older age, by pressuring him to agree to a new arrangement under time constraints.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>At that point, Pierre Levesque and Costa Cronis discussed the situation and decided to contact their nephew, Matthew Wallace, to explain what was happening and seek guidance. After this discussion, Pierre and Costa stepped away.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Despite no work being performed, the Harmony Movers staff remained on site and continued charging hourly fees, even though they were not moving any equipment and were only attempting to renegotiate the contract.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Pierre Levesque then spoke directly with Matthew Wallace and stated:</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>“Matthew, I do not agree with what they are trying to do right now. We have a contract, and they are supposed to respect it. We have a deadline. This equipment must be out of the space by tomorrow. We are not in a position to call another company. I do not agree with any modification to this contract.”</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>After this conversation ended, Matthew Wallace contacted Lev, the owner of Harmony Movers. Matthew explicitly informed Lev that he was on his way to the site, that he was renting a U-Haul truck in order to move the pastry equipment into storage, and that he would arrive within approximately one hour to assess the situation in person.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Matthew also made it clear to Lev that:</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>No contract changes were authorized</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>All requests or proposed changes had to be sent by email</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>An explanation was required as to why Harmony Movers was attempting to change pricing when a contract had already been signed and clearly defined the scope of work</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Lev acknowledged this and stated that they would send the information by email.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>During this time, Harmony Movers continued attempting to negotiate directly with Pierre Levesque. Pierre Levesque and Costa Cronis, meanwhile, continued their duties on site and began preparing the restaurant contents by placing items into boxes, as the entire restaurant had to be cleared by the following day.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>At approximately 2:30 p.m., Matthew Wallace Barnard arrived on site with two employees. Matthew and his two employees immediately began moving the pastry equipment into the U-Haul truck parked outside in order to clear space and comply with the landlord’s deadline.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Harmony Movers then began moving some equipment as well. Shortly thereafter, the owner of Harmony Movers arrived on site. He walked around the premises inspecting the equipment and approached Matthew Wallace, asking whether the Coca-Cola refrigerators were for sale, stating that they might be interested in purchasing them.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Matthew replied that all of the equipment belonged to a pizzeria and had to be relocated to another location, as Pierre Levesque intended to open a new restaurant elsewhere.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>The owner then stated that they were not sending an additional truck and again attempted to push for a change in rates and pricing. Matthew reiterated that he was not the owner, that he could not authorize any changes, and that any requests had to be sent by email so the owner could review them before authorizing anything. This email was not sent immediately and was only sent later in the afternoon.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>The job continued for several hours. By approximately 4:00 p.m., Harmony Movers claimed that their truck was fully loaded and that they needed to proceed with delivery. Matthew then requested that Harmony Movers assist in loading some equipment into the U-Haul truck in order to maximize efficiency and help clear the space, particularly since they were charging by the hour and were claiming that a second truck would be required.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Instead of proceeding to the agreed destination, Harmony Movers left the site and did not deliver the equipment as stipulated in the contract. They transported the equipment to their own warehouse and demanded payment before delivery.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Additionally, Harmony Movers left critical equipment behind, including:</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>A double-stack pizza oven</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Other pizzeria equipment</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>A refrigerator</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>These actions clearly demonstrated that they had no intention of completing the job as contracted, which required removal and delivery of all pizzeria equipment to the designated destination.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Harmony Movers unilaterally changed the destination, attempted to increase pricing, and imposed new conditions without any agreement or authorization, despite the existence of a signed contract that they were obligated to respect.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>At this point, Pierre Levesque was in a state of confusion and distress, but was fully aware that if the equipment was not removed by the next day, ownership could revert to the landlord. As a result of Harmony Movers’ actions, Pierre Levesque was forced to urgently hire another company to move the remaining pizza oven, refrigerator, and other equipment that Harmony Movers had abandoned on site.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><br></div><div dir=\"auto\">3) les échanges post enlèvement .  Les différents montants réclamés </div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Unjustified Revised Charges and Attempted Contract Modification</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Upon reviewing the revised submission that was sent later that same day, it became clear that Harmony Movers was attempting to impose new and unjustified charges that were never agreed upon and were not supported by the facts on site.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>First, they attempted to charge for a second truck, despite the fact that no second truck ever arrived on site at any time during the move.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Second, they attempted to charge for additional staff. However, the only additional individuals who arrived on site beyond the original moving crew were the owners of the company themselves, and these individuals did not move, lift, or handle any equipment or materials from the premises. No additional labor services were provided that would justify such charges.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Third, they attempted to charge again for heavy-duty or heavyweight equipment. It is important to note that from the outset, it was clearly agreed and acknowledged that this was a restaurant move involving heavy equipment, and a specific fee of $1,800 had already been agreed upon for heavy-duty equipment and excess weight.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>Despite this clear agreement, Harmony Movers attempted to charge a second heavy-equipment fee, amounting to nearly $3,000, effectively billing twice for the same category of service. This duplication of charges is entirely inconsistent with the original agreement and has no factual or contractual basis.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>These attempted charges are particularly unjustifiable given that Harmony Movers was fully aware, prior to accepting the job and signing the contract, that they were coming to move a complete pizzeria, including restaurant equipment. The nature of the equipment was disclosed, documented with photographs, and discussed before the contract was executed.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>The attempt to impose these additional fees, increase the hourly rate, and introduce a new pricing structure after arrival on site, under severe time pressure and with full knowledge of the landlord’s eviction deadline, was not a legitimate contractual adjustment. It constituted an attempt to coerce payment through pressure, rather than a good-faith modification of services.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b>At that point, the conduct amounted to extortion, as the company sought to leverage the urgent circumstances to extract additional payment without justification, authorization, or contractual support.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\">4). La journée de la saisie.  Comment ça s’est passé ?   Des menaces ?   La police ?   Collaboration des employés ?   L’avocat a-t-il menacé ou tenter d’intimider le huissier ? color=\"#f44336\"><b>The equipment was recovered in damaged condition, following negligent storage, unjustified delays, and clear resistance to lawful enforcement.</b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#f44336\"><b><br></b></font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><br></div><div dir=\"auto\">Photo et description ou les équipements sont présentement .  </div><div dir=\"auto\"><br></div><div dir=\"auto\"><b><font color=\"#f44336\">Current Location and Condition of the Equipment</font></b></div><div dir=\"auto\"><b><font color=\"#f44336\">The equipment is presently located at 5505 Rue Irwin, LaSalle, Quebec, where it has been placed in two storage containers within a storage unit. The containers are properly sealed, securely closed, and stored in a heated environment. The equipment inside has been laid out and stored in an organized and appropriate manner to prevent further deterioration.</font></b></div><div dir=\"auto\"><b><font color=\"#f44336\">At this time, we are awaiting the intervention of a qualified technician who will be responsible for evaluating the condition of the equipment, assessing all damages sustained, and determining whether the equipment can be repaired, salvaged, or must be declared unusable or scrap.</font></b></div><div dir=\"auto\"><b><font color=\"#f44336\">This evaluation process will require additional time, particularly due to the holiday period, which limits immediate availability. Furthermore, arranging for a technician to attend the site involves financial costs, scheduling delays, and proper coordination with the appropriate professionals and organizations.</font></b></div><div dir=\"auto\"><b><font color=\"#f44336\">Until this evaluation is completed, the full extent of the damages and associated repair or replacement costs cannot yet be determined.</font></b></div><div dir=\"auto\"><br></div><div dir=\"auto\">On fait quoi avec les pertes de revenus qu’on réclame?  Va falloir en faire la preuve et remettre tout document comptable ou autre </div><div dir=\"auto\"><br></div><div dir=\"auto\"><b><font color=\"#f44336\">En analyse </font></b></div><div dir=\"auto\"><b><font color=\"#f44336\"><br></font></b></div><div dir=\"auto\"><font color=\"#000000\">Détail de combien ça coûté reprendre les biens </font></div><div dir=\"auto\"><br></div><div dir=\"auto\"><b><font color=\"#f44336\">Costs Incurred as a Direct Result of the Move and Obstruction</font></b></div><div dir=\"auto\"><b><font color=\"#f44336\">The costs associated with the relocation of the equipment and the actions that followed are substantial and were incurred solely due to the circumstances created by Harmony Movers.</font></b></div><div dir=\"auto\"><b><font color=\"#f44336\">First, court-related expenses were required in order to obtain the CESI and to file the demande d’acheminement / agissement necessary to legally proceed with the recovery and relocation of the equipment. An amount of $2,000 was paid to the bailiff (huissier) to execute the legal process and attend the site in order to enforce the court authority related to the recovery of the equipment.</font></b></div><div dir=\"auto\"><b><font color=\"#f44336\">Second, an amount of $469 was paid to U-Haul for the rental of a truck, including the cost of the vehicle, fuel, and mileage, which became necessary due to the failure of Harmony Movers to complete the move as contracted.</font></b></div><div dir=\"auto\"><b><font color=\"#f44336\">Third, we incurred an additional expense of approximately $2,000 for an alternative moving company, which was urgently required to provide personnel and assistance to move the remaining equipment from Lachine to LaSalle and place it into the new storage location.</font></b></div><div dir=\"auto\"><b><font color=\"#f44336\">In addition, we incurred a further expense of $400 for specialized equipment and tools required to safely load, secure, transport, and unload the heavy-duty restaurant equipment into the truck and into the new storage facility. These tools and materials were necessary to complete the move due to the nature and weight of the equipment involved.</font></b></div><div dir=\"auto\"><b><font color=\"#f44336\">It is important to note that many of these costs could have been significantly reduced or avoided entirely had Harmony Movers complied with their contractual obligations and acted in good faith. Instead, Harmony Movers delayed the process, obstructed the execution of the move, and interfered with the bailiff’s mandate, deliberately staggering time and preventing the bailiff from executing the recovery in a timely and lawful manner.</font></b></div><div dir=\"auto\"><b><font color=\"#f44336\">The bailiff explicitly warned Harmony Movers that their conduct was illegal, that they were tampering with a judicial officer, and that such actions exposed them to serious legal consequences, including the risk of arrest. Despite these warnings, Harmony Movers persisted in their obstructive behavior.</font></b></div><div dir=\"auto\"><b><font color=\"#f44336\">As a direct result of this conduct, we were forced to incur additional legal, logistical, and operational expenses that would not otherwise have been necessary.</font></b></div></div>\r\n</div>\r\n",

                      "content": "---------- Forwarded message ---------\r\nFrom: Stephane Cohen <stephane@sclegal.ca>\r\nDate: Thu, Feb 12, 2026, 09:40\r\nSubject: Re: Demande urgente de représentation – Dossier Quadro Holdings\r\nLtée c. 2M4\r\ntel: (514) 886-3710\r\nfax: (438) 896-2786\r\n\r\nOn Feb 12, 2026, at 9:27 AM, Oeuf Déjeuner <ooeuf.ca@gmail.com> wrote:\r\n\r\n﻿\r\nBonjour,\r\n\r\nNous sollicitons votre assistance urgente afin d’obtenir une représentation\r\njuridique pour notre entreprise, Quadro Holdings Ltée, dans un litige\r\nactuellement devant la Cour supérieure du Québec.\r\n\r\nNous sommes impliqués dans un dossier opposant notre entreprise à la\r\ncompagnie Harmony Movers (9205-2471 Québec inc.), dans lequel une demande\r\nintroductive d’instance avec saisie avant jugement a été déposée, puis\r\namendée en janvier 2026.\r\n\r\nNotre procureur initial est présentement indisponible pour des raisons\r\npersonnelles, ce qui nous place dans une situation critique sur le plan\r\nprocédural. La partie adverse a récemment entrepris des démarches visant le\r\nrejet de notre demande, invoquant l’absence de représentation dans les\r\ndélais.\r\n\r\nCompte tenu des échéances imminentes et des enjeux financiers importants,\r\nnous sommes activement à la recherche d’un avocat pouvant prendre le\r\ndossier en charge dans les plus brefs délais.\r\n\r\nLe dossier concerne notamment :\r\n\r\n- La rétention illégale d’équipements commerciaux d’une valeur estimée à\r\nplus de 250 000 $ ;\r\n- Des pertes d’exploitation et dommages réclamés ;\r\n- Une saisie avant jugement déjà exécutée ;\r\n- Une demande en rejet présentable prochainement devant le tribunal.\r\n\r\nNous sommes en mesure de fournir immédiatement l’ensemble des documents,\r\nprocédures, pièces et communications nécessaires à l’analyse du dossier.\r\n\r\nNous vous serions reconnaissants de bien vouloir nous indiquer rapidement\r\nsi vous êtes en mesure d’assurer notre représentation ou, à défaut, de nous\r\nréférer à un confrère disponible.\r\n\r\nÉtant donné l’urgence de la situation, nous demeurons disponibles en tout\r\ntemps pour un appel ou une rencontre rapide.\r\n\r\nNous vous remercions sincèrement de votre attention et espérons pouvoir\r\ncompter sur votre collaboration.\r\n\r\nVeuillez agréer, nos salutations distinguées.\r\n\r\nCordialement,\r\n\r\nPierre Lévesque\r\nQuadro Holdings Ltée\r\nTéléphone : 514-458-4587\r\n\r\n<2026-01-26 DII Amendée Quadro.pdf>\r\n",

Provenance et contrôle des pièces

Les originaux, les déclarations et les analyses sont identifiés par leur provenance. Les doublons et les versions d’une facture ne s’additionnent pas. Une extraction OCR reste à contrôler sur la pièce originale. Les documents à obtenir et les vérifications ouvertes figurent dans les synthèses de chaque dossier.

Les pièces d’origine restent dans leurs dossiers. L’index est une copie de travail datée; une recherche sans résultat ne démontre pas l’absence d’une pièce. Les synchronisations OneDrive et GitHub sont distinctes.
